title: Canceling stamps: First qualifying slip
summary: Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index.
descriptionMd:
Matching cancellation stamps erase each other when they meet at the top of the paper pile. Tomas needs the first qualifying slip while the courier waits at the door. Later matches must not jump ahead in the tray.

Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top.

Return the first value in the derived sequence that is at least k, or -1 if there is none. Return the value, not its index.

Implement cancelingStampsFirstQualifyingSlip(readings, k). Use k exactly where specified above.
unitIntro: Stack cancellation. Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
